nights.title: Ax and the Hatchetmen: The Late Checkout Tour 2026 w/ The Rare Occasions
nights.name: Ax and the Hatchetmen
nights.extract: Ax and the Hatchetmen are an American alternative/indie rock band formed in Chicago in 2018. Members of the group include Axel Ellis, Salvatore Defilippis (vocals/guitar), Hunter Olshefke (vocals/bass), Phil Pistone (trumpet), Quinn Dolan (saxophone), and Chaandmon Croft (drums). They are signed with Arista Records and their first album, So Much to Tell You, was released October 24, 2025 with a tour of the same name.

en.kicker: american alternative and indie rock band · chicago, 2018
en.who: Ax and the Hatchetmen are an American alternative and indie rock band formed in Chicago in 2018. The group has six listed members, including vocalists Salvatore Defilippis and Hunter Olshefke.
facts: They are signed with Arista Records and their first album, So Much to Tell You, was released October 24, 2025 with a tour of the same name.
Members of the group include Axel Ellis, Salvatore Defilippis (vocals/guitar), Hunter Olshefke (vocals/bass), Phil Pistone (trumpet), Quinn Dolan (saxophone), and Chaandmon Croft (drums).

de.who: Ax and the Hatchetmen sind eine amerikanische Alternative- und Indie-Rockband, die 2018 in Chicago gegründet wurde. Zur Gruppe gehören sechs aufgeführte Mitglieder, darunter Salvatore Defilippis und Hunter Olshefke am Gesang.
facts: Sie stehen bei Arista Records unter Vertrag, und ihr erstes Album So Much to Tell You erschien am 24. Oktober 2025 zusammen mit einer gleichnamigen Tour.
Zur Gruppe gehören Axel Ellis, Salvatore Defilippis (Gesang/Gitarre), Hunter Olshefke (Gesang/Bass), Phil Pistone (Trompete), Quinn Dolan (Saxofon) und Chaandmon Croft (Schlagzeug).

tr.who: Ax and the Hatchetmen, 2018'de Chicago'da kurulmuş Amerikalı bir alternatif ve indie rock grubudur. Grubun listelenen altı üyesi arasında vokalistler Salvatore Defilippis ve Hunter Olshefke yer alıyor.
facts: Grup Arista Records ile çalışıyor; ilk albümleri So Much to Tell You, aynı adlı turne ile birlikte 24 Ekim 2025'te yayımlandı.
Grubun üyeleri arasında Axel Ellis, Salvatore Defilippis (vokal/gitar), Hunter Olshefke (vokal/bas), Phil Pistone (trompet), Quinn Dolan (saksofon) ve Chaandmon Croft (davul) bulunuyor.

nights.title: Gorillaz - The Mountain Tour
nights.name: Gorillaz
nights.extract: Gorillaz are an English virtual alternative rock band formed in 1998 by the musician Damon Albarn and the artist Jamie Hewlett. The band primarily consists of four fictional members: 2-D, Murdoc Niccals, Noodle and Russel Hobbs (drums). Their universe is presented in media such as music videos, interviews, comic strips and short cartoons. Gorillaz's music has featured collaborations with a wide range of musicians and featured artists, with Albarn as the only permanent musical contributor.

en.who: Gorillaz were formed in 1998 by Damon Albarn and Jamie Hewlett. Albarn is the only permanent musical contributor, and the band works with many featured artists.
facts: The band primarily consists of four fictional members: 2-D, Murdoc Niccals, Noodle and Russel Hobbs (drums).
Their universe is presented in media such as music videos, interviews, comic strips and short cartoons.

de.who: Gorillaz wurde 1998 von Damon Albarn und Jamie Hewlett gegründet. Albarn ist der einzige dauerhafte musikalische Mitwirkende, während die Band mit vielen Gastmusikern zusammenarbeitet.
facts: Die Band besteht hauptsächlich aus vier fiktiven Mitgliedern: 2-D, Murdoc Niccals, Noodle und Russel Hobbs (Schlagzeug).
Ihr Universum wird in Medien wie Musikvideos, Interviews, Comicstrips und kurzen Zeichentrickfilmen präsentiert.

tr.who: Gorillaz, 1998'de Damon Albarn ve Jamie Hewlett tarafından kuruldu. Albarn, grubun tek kalıcı müzikal katkıcısıdır; grup birçok konuk sanatçıyla çalışmaktadır.
facts: Grup esas olarak dört kurgusal üyeden oluşur: 2-D, Murdoc Niccals, Noodle ve Russel Hobbs (davul).
Evrenleri müzik videoları, röportajlar, çizgi romanlar ve kısa animasyonlar gibi medyalarda sunulmaktadır.

nights.title: Sienna Spiro
nights.name: Sienna Spiro
nights.extract: Sienna Ann Spiro is an English singer-songwriter and record producer. Known for her distinct, powerful voice, she began sharing viral singing videos on TikTok in 2021. She started releasing music in 2024, including "Maybe", which became her debut on the UK Singles Chart. She released Sink Now, Swim Later, her debut extended play, in February 2025. Her breakthrough success came with the release of "Die on This Hill", which charted in numerous countries. She released her debut studio album, Visitor, on 3 July 2026, and achieved her first UK number one single with its track "Great Expectation".

en.who: Sienna Ann Spiro is an English singer-songwriter and record producer known for her distinct, powerful voice. She began sharing viral singing videos on TikTok in 2021 and started releasing music in 2024.
facts: She released her debut studio album, Visitor, on 3 July 2026, and achieved her first UK number one single with its track "Great Expectation".
Her breakthrough success came with the release of "Die on This Hill", which charted in numerous countries.

de.who: Sienna Ann Spiro ist eine englische Singer-Songwriterin und Musikproduzentin mit einer markanten, kraftvollen Stimme. Sie teilte 2021 virale Gesangsvideos auf TikTok und begann 2024 mit Veröffentlichungen.
facts: Sie veröffentlichte ihr Debütstudioalbum Visitor am 3. Juli 2026 und erreichte mit dem Titel „Great Expectation“ ihre erste Nummer eins in Großbritannien.
Ihr Durchbruch kam mit der Veröffentlichung von „Die on This Hill“, der in zahlreichen Ländern die Charts erreichte.

tr.who: Sienna Ann Spiro, belirgin ve güçlü sesiyle bilinen İngiliz bir şarkıcı, söz yazarı ve yapımcıdır. 2021'de TikTok'ta viral olan şarkı videoları paylaşmaya başladı ve 2024'te müzik yayımlamaya başladı.
facts: Debut stüdyo albümü Visitor'ı 3 Temmuz 2026'da yayımladı ve "Great Expectation" parçasıyla İngiltere'de ilk numaralı single'ına ulaştı.
Atılımı "Die on This Hill" şarkısının yayımlanmasıyla geldi; şarkı birçok ülkede listelere girdi.

nights.title: Icon for Hire
nights.name: Icon for Hire
nights.extract: Icon for Hire is an American rock band from Decatur, Illinois. Formed in 2007, the band's current lineup consists of singer Ariel Bloomer and lead guitarist Shawn Jump. They released two EPs independently before signing to Tooth & Nail Records, through which they released their first two albums: Scripted in 2011 and Icon for Hire on October 15, 2013. Their third album, You Can't Kill Us, was independently released on November 25, 2016. Their fourth album, Amorphous, was released on February 19, 2021, also independently. Their fifth independent studio album, The Reckoning, was released on September 30, 2022.

en.who: Icon for Hire is an American rock band from Decatur, Illinois. The band signed to Tooth & Nail Records, which released its first two albums, Scripted and Icon for Hire.
facts: Formed in 2007, the band's current lineup consists of singer Ariel Bloomer and lead guitarist Shawn Jump.
Their fifth independent studio album, The Reckoning, was released on September 30, 2022.

de.who: Icon for Hire ist eine amerikanische Rockband aus Decatur, Illinois. Die Band wechselte zu Tooth & Nail Records, bei dem die ersten beiden Alben Scripted und Icon for Hire erschienen.
facts: Die Band wurde 2007 gegründet; ihre aktuelle Besetzung umfasst Ariel Bloomer am Gesang und Shawn Jump an der Leadgitarre.
Ihr fünftes unabhängiges Studioalbum The Reckoning erschien am 30. September 2022.

tr.who: Icon for Hire, Illinois eyaletinin Decatur kentinden Amerikalı bir rock grubudur. Grup, ilk iki albümünü yayımladığı Tooth & Nail Records ile anlaştı: Scripted ve Icon for Hire.
facts: Grup 2007'de kuruldu; güncel kadrosu vokalde Ariel Bloomer ve solo gitarda Shawn Jump'tan oluşuyor.
Beşinci bağımsız stüdyo albümü The Reckoning, 30 Eylül 2022'de yayımlandı.

nights.title: Pinhead Gunpowder
nights.name: Pinhead Gunpowder
nights.extract: Pinhead Gunpowder is an American punk rock band that formed in the East Bay area of California, in 1991. The band currently consists of Aaron Cometbus, Bill Schneider (bass), Billie Joe Armstrong and Jason White. The band's name comes from a brand of "high-octane" green tea served at the Arcata co-op that was discovered by Aaron Cometbus during one of his many dumpster diving adventures.

en.who: Pinhead Gunpowder is an American punk rock band formed in the East Bay area of California in 1991. Its members currently include Aaron Cometbus, Bill Schneider, Billie Joe Armstrong and Jason White.
facts: The band currently consists of Aaron Cometbus, Bill Schneider (bass), Billie Joe Armstrong and Jason White.

de.who: Pinhead Gunpowder ist eine amerikanische Punkrockband, die 1991 im Gebiet der East Bay in Kalifornien gegründet wurde. Zur Band gehören derzeit Aaron Cometbus, Bill Schneider, Billie Joe Armstrong und Jason White.

nights.title: Jessie Reyez: A Little Vengeance Tour
nights.name: Jessie Reyez
nights.extract: Jessica Reyez is a Canadian singer-songwriter. Her 2016 single, "Figures", peaked at number 58 on the Canadian Hot 100 and received triple platinum certification by Music Canada (MC) and platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). Her debut extended play (EP), Kiddo (2017), led her to win Breakthrough Artist from four nominations at the 2018 Juno Awards. Her second EP, Being Human in Public (2018), was released the following year, won R&B/Soul Recording of the Year at the 2019 Juno Awards, and was nominated for Best Urban Contemporary Album at the 2020 Grammy Awards.

en.who: Jessica Reyez is a Canadian singer-songwriter. Her debut EP, Kiddo (2017), led to her winning Breakthrough Artist at the 2018 Juno Awards.
facts: Her 2016 single, "Figures", peaked at number 58 on the Canadian Hot 100 and received triple platinum certification by Music Canada (MC) and platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA).

de.who: Jessica Reyez ist eine kanadische Singer-Songwriterin. Ihre Debüt-EP Kiddo (2017) führte dazu, dass sie bei den Juno Awards 2018 als Breakthrough Artist gewann.

nights.title: Plini - An Unnameable Desire North American Tour w/ Night Verses & Portraits
nights.name: Plini
nights.extract: Plini Roessler-Holgate, known mononymously as Plini, is an Australian guitarist and songwriter. He began his career by releasing music under the name Halcyon, before switching to the use of his first name. Steve Vai described him as "the future of exceptional guitar playing", and the website MusicRadar named Plini the best prog guitarist of 2017.

en.who: Plini Roessler-Holgate, known mononymously as Plini, is an Australian guitarist and songwriter. He began his career releasing music as Halcyon before switching to his first name.
facts: Steve Vai described him as "the future of exceptional guitar playing".

facts: Steve Vai onu "olağanüstü gitar çalmanın geleceği" olarak tanımladı.

nights.title: Seattle Symphony
nights.name: Seattle Symphony
nights.extract: The Seattle Symphony is an American orchestra based in Seattle, Washington. Since 1998, the orchestra is resident at Benaroya Hall. The orchestra also serves as the accompanying orchestra for the Seattle Opera.

en.who: The Seattle Symphony is an American orchestra based in Seattle, Washington. It has been resident at Benaroya Hall since 1998 and also accompanies the Seattle Opera.
facts: Since 1998, the orchestra is resident at Benaroya Hall.
The orchestra also serves as the accompanying orchestra for the Seattle Opera.

de.who: Das Seattle Symphony ist ein amerikanisches Orchester mit Sitz in Seattle, Washington. Seit 1998 ist es im Benaroya Hall ansässig und begleitet außerdem die Seattle Opera.
facts: Seit 1998 ist das Orchester im Benaroya Hall ansässig.
Das Orchester fungiert außerdem als Begleitorchester der Seattle Opera.

tr.who: Seattle Symphony, Washington eyaletinin Seattle kentinde kurulu Amerikalı bir orkestradır. 1998'den beri Benaroya Hall'da ikamet etmekte ve Seattle Opera'ya eşlik etmektedir.
facts: 1998'den beri orkestra Benaroya Hall'da ikamet etmektedir.

nights.title: The Tallest Man on Earth
nights.name: The Tallest Man on Earth
nights.extract: Kristian Matsson is a Swedish singer-songwriter who performs under the stage name The Tallest Man on Earth. Matsson grew up in Leksand, and began his solo career in 2006, having previously been the lead singer of the indie band Montezumas. His music has often drawn comparisons to the music of Bob Dylan.

en.who: Kristian Matsson is a Swedish singer-songwriter who performs as The Tallest Man on Earth. He grew up in Leksand and began his solo career in 2006 after leading the indie band Montezumas.

Seine Musik wurde oft mit der Musik von Bob Dylan verglichen.

nights.title: Teddy Swims: The UGLY Tour
nights.name: Teddy Swims
nights.extract: Jaten Collin Dimsdale, known professionally as Teddy Swims, is an American singer and songwriter. Known for creating genre-blending music that includes elements of R&B, soul, hip-hop, and contemporary pop, Swims originally began to attract fans by posting song covers on YouTube during 2019 and 2020. Swims' third extended play, Tough Love (2022), became his first entry on the Billboard 200.

facts: Swims begann ursprünglich, Fans zu gewinnen, indem er 2019 und 2020 auf YouTube Songcover veröffentlichte.

facts: Swims, 2019 ve 2020 yıllarında YouTube'da şarkı kapakları paylaşarak ilk hayranlarını kazanmaya başladı.
Swims'in üçüncü extended play'i Tough Love (2022), Billboard 200'de ilk yer alan çalışması oldu.

nights.title: Marc Broussard
nights.name: Marc Broussard
nights.extract: Marc Broussard is an American singer-songwriter. His style is best described as "bayou soul", a mix of funk, blues, R&B, rock and pop, matched with distinct Southern roots. He has released twelve studio albums, one live album, and three EPs, and has charted twice on Hot Adult Top 40 Tracks.

facts: Sein Stil wird am besten als „bayou soul“ beschrieben, eine Mischung aus Funk, Blues, R&B, Rock und Pop mit ausgeprägten südlichen Wurzeln.

nights.title: Periphery - A Pale White Dot US Tour
nights.name: Periphery
nights.extract: Periphery is an American progressive metal band that was formed in Washington, D.C., in 2005. Their musical style has been described as progressive metal, djent, and progressive metalcore. They are considered one of the pioneers of the djent movement within progressive metal. They have also received a Grammy nomination. The band consists of vocalist Spencer Sotelo, guitarists Misha Mansoor, Mark Holcomb, Jake Bowen, and drummer Matt Halpern.

facts: Sie gilt als eine der Pioniere der Djent-Bewegung innerhalb des Progressive Metal.
Zur Band gehören Vokalist Spencer Sotelo, die Gitarristen Misha Mansoor, Mark Holcomb, Jake Bowen und Schlagzeuger Matt Halpern.

facts: Progressive metal içinde djent hareketinin öncülerinden biri olarak kabul edilmektedir.

nights.title: The Smashing Pumpkins: The Rats In A Cage Tour
nights.name: The Smashing Pumpkins
nights.extract: The Smashing Pumpkins is an American alternative rock band formed in Chicago in 1988 by lead vocalist and guitarist Billy Corgan, guitarist James Iha, bassist D'arcy Wretzky, and drummer Jimmy Chamberlin. The band has undergone several line-up changes since their reunion in 2006, with Corgan being the primary songwriter and sole constant member since its inception. The current lineup consists of Corgan, Iha, and Chamberlin. The band is known for its diverse, densely layered sound, which evolved throughout their career and has integrated elements of gothic rock, heavy metal, grunge, psychedelic rock, progressive rock, shoegaze, dream pop, and electronica.

en.who: The Smashing Pumpkins is an American alternative rock band formed in Chicago in 1988 by Billy Corgan, James Iha, D'arcy Wretzky and Jimmy Chamberlin. Corgan is the primary songwriter and the only constant member since the band began.

facts: Die aktuelle Besetzung besteht aus Corgan, Iha und Chamberlin.
Die Band hat seit ihrer Wiedervereinigung 2006 mehrere Besetzungswechsel erlebt; Corgan ist dabei der wichtigste Songwriter und seit ihrer Gründung das einzige konstante Mitglied.

facts: Güncel kadro Corgan, Iha ve Chamberlin'den oluşmaktadır.

nights.title: Deante' Hitchcock
nights.name: Deante' Hitchcock
nights.extract: Deante' Van Hitchcock, is an American rapper from Riverdale, Georgia. He initially gained recognition as a rapper following the releases of three mixtapes: 19 Summers (2012), Wishful Thinking (2015) and Good (2016). He received widespread attention on the internet in 2016 after a weekly series of freestyles called New Atlanta Tuesday's. In 2017, he signed to ByStorm and RCA Records. His debut album Better was released on May 13, 2020.

facts: In 2017, he signed to ByStorm and RCA Records.
His debut album Better was released on May 13, 2020.

facts: 2017'de ByStorm ve RCA Records ile anlaştı.

nights.title: Dax
nights.name: Dax
nights.extract: Daniel Nwosu Jr., professionally known by his stage name Dax, is a Nigerian-Canadian and American singer and rapper. He has recorded three albums, Pain Paints Paintings (2021), From a Man's Perspective (2024) and Anger Management (2026). He has achieved certifications in Canada and the United States for his singles "Dear God", "Dear Alcohol" and "To Be a Man."

nights.name: Sammy Virji
nights.extract: Samuel Bashir Virji is a British DJ and record producer. Born in London, he grew up in Witney, and attended Newcastle University before dropping out to pursue his music career. His 2020 album, Spice Up My Life, charted at No. 7 on the UK Dance Albums Chart. After releasing a remix of Piri & Tommy's "On & On", he released "If U Need It", which charted at No. 85 on the UK singles chart. His earlier works belonged to the bassline genre, while his later works were UK garage.

nights.title: Exhumed
nights.name: Exhumed
nights.extract: Exhumed is an American death metal band formed in San Jose, California, currently signed to Relapse Records. It revolves around leader, vocalist-guitarist, and sole constant member, Matt Harvey. The band has released nine albums and eight split 7-inch singles. They were formed in 1990, went on hiatus in 2005, and reformed in 2010.
